text.text_excerpt: This is my favorite location of all the Robert markets. I like the one on Robert E Lee, too, but the people are much nicer at the Claiborne one. Both have kind of nutty parking lots. Hmm. Anyway, grocery shopping is almost a pleasure here. If Whole Foods is too froo-froo and Rouse's makes you a little crazy, Robert is the perfect median. The produce is beautiful, the deli and wine shop will save you from any kind of entertaining disaster, and your normal, everyday needs will surely be met by the excellent blend of mass market and gourmet/boutique products. Here is where I buy a bottle of sake. Here is where I can find my Honey Bunches of Oats with Peaches, the holy grail of cereal. And no...

Robert's is my go to neighborhood grocery store! What I like most about shopping here is the selection of fresh meat, seafood, produce, local food offerings, florals, and the store employees. I know practically all of the cashiers by name! The day time manager, David is by far the nicest most dutiful employee. He's all around the store making sure it's running smoothly. Short lines, organized, fully stocked shelves with friendly faces, what more could you ask for from your local grocer?! During Hurricane Ida, Roberts stood up and provided food and cleaning essentials in time of need. Shopping here can be a little pricey but it's worth it to get quality food and good customer service.

We found ourselves living around the corner from this place. The deli was amazing. Plus the prepared foods are perfect when you need to bring something to a party that looks homemade. Yeah, I'm that person. My favorite item they carry aside from their PB cookies which are *AWESOME* is their line of locally sourced chipotle/fruit pepper jellies. Pour that stuff over cream cheese and it is TO DIE for. I appreciate that they carry the lesser-available Les Croix sparkling waters. Service is great. Parking lot is safe and secure.
